These platforms incorporate processors, interconnects, software, algorithms, systems, and services to deliver unique value. Our platforms address large markets where our expertise is critical: Data Center and Edge Computing. We plan to file our 10-Q in the coming weeks. In the interim, we have provided a supplemental document with additional financial information on our investor website. Revenue Revenue for the third quarter was a record $115.8 billion, up 103% from a year ago and up 20% sequentially. Data Center revenue for the third quarter was a record $107.6 b
n, up 110% from a year ago and up 21% sequentially. Our Hyperscale and AI Clouds, Industrial, & Enterprise platforms both grew substantially, driven by the introduction of our Rubin infrastructure, our fastest architecture ramp ever, standalone Vera CPUs and the continued growth of Blackwell Ultra. Shipments of Data Center Hopper products to China during the quarter were $2.4 billion. Edge Computing revenue for the third quarter was $8.2 billion, up 42% from a year ago and up 14% sequentially. Strong Blackwell workstation sales and edge compute for Physical AI applications drove the increases, while higher memory and system prices continue to affect consumer PC demand. Gross Mar
red into strategic commitments across our supply, infrastructure, and partner ecosystems to capitalize on future growth opportunities and support our business. We've partnered with our extensive network of suppliers to secure the critical components needed to meet demand for the next several years. Our supply commitments increased from $279 billion last quarter to $390 billion, primarily related to the multi-year procurement of memory supply. Our cloud service agreements and data center lease commitments together of $102 billion, an increase from last quarter's $74 billion, provide the physical and cloud infrastructure that powers our research and development — from the engineering, product design, and testing of our compute chips, netw
eases to OpenAI, subject to limited exceptions. Our guarantees take effect phase by phase, with each one becoming effective only when its related building is completed and ready for service. The first is expected in fiscal 2029. Our exposure therefore builds over time as each building comes online, up to a maximum of $105 billion, and then declines over each 20-year lease term as OpenAI makes lease payments. We also have the option to provide credit support in phases for approximately 3.8 additional GW as the site scales. To date, we have not made any payments related to our guarantees. cash dividends. In September 2026, our Board of Directors approved an increase of $150 billion to our share repurchase authorization, without expiration. At the end of our third quarter, we had $227.3 billion of share repurchase authorization remaining which we plan to utilize through fiscal 2028. Accounts receivable was $81.0 billion with 64 days sales outstanding (DSO), up from 60 days sequentially, driven by shipment linearity from our Rubin launch and extended payment terms on large, multi-quarter agreements with certain investment-grade customers. Inventory was $39.7 billion, up from $31.6 billion sequentially, to support our Rubin product ramp. Cash flow from operating activities was $48.3 billion, up from $23.8 billion a year ago and up from $24.1 billion a quarter ago. The year-on-year increases reflect growth in revenue, while the sequential increase was also impacted by the timing of federal cash tax payments. We repaid $1.0 billion of senior notes in the third quarter. Outlook Outlook for the fourth quarter of fiscal 2027, which includes an additional week, is as follows: • Revenue is expected to be $130.0 billion, plus or minus 3%. We are not assuming any Data Center compute revenue from China in our outlook. • GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins are expected to be between 71.0% and 72.0%. • GAAP and non-GAAP operating expenses are expected to be approximately $11.0 billion and $10.7 billion, respectively. For the full year fiscal 2027, we expect GAAP and non-GAAP tax rates to be between 16.0% and 18.0%, ex
GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins decreased slightly sequentially, reflecting the initial Rubin ramp.

For the third quarter of fiscal year 2027, three direct customers represented 14%, 11%, and 11% of total revenue, all of which were primarily attributable to the Compute & Networking segment. nsition period for complying with any new or revised financial accounting standards provided pursuant to Section 13(a) of the Exchange Act. ☐ Item 5.02. Departure of Directors or Certain Officers; Election of Directors; Appointment of Certain Officers; Compensatory Arrangements of Certain Officers. On November 11, 2026, the Board of Directors, or the Board, of NVIDIA Corporation accepted the resignation of Jen-Hsun Huang, as NVIDIA's President, Chief Executive Officer and member of the Board, effective immediately. Following Mr. Huang's resignation, the Board appointed NVIDIA's Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer Colette M. Kress, age 59, to serve as interim Chief Executive Officer, while the Board conducts a search for a new Chief Executive Officer. Ms. Kress has served as NVIDIA's Executive

@@ https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000090/nvda-20261122.htm
nsition period for complying with any new or revised financial accounting standards provided pursuant to Section 13(a) of the Exchange Act. ☐ Item 5.02. Departure of Directors or Certain Officers; Election of Directors; Appointment of Certain Officers; Compensatory Arrangements of Certain Officers. On November 22, 2026, the Board of Directors of NVIDIA Corporation reinstated Jen-Hsun Huang as NVIDIA's President, Chief Executive Officer and member of the Board of Directors, effective immediately. Following the reinstatement of Mr. Huang, Ms. Kress will continue to serve as NVIDIA's Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer. A copy of the press release announcing the above is attached as Exhibit 99.1 to this Current Report on Form 8-K. Item 9.01. Financial Statements and Exhibits.
